metadata.methods_description: Data collection involved a large-scale online behavioral survey (500 participants) rating 40 validated video stimuli using Self-Assessment Manikin (SAM) scales for valence and arousal, discrete emotion categories (PrEmo), and temporal highlight scene selections. MEG recordings were obtained from 23 participants viewing the same video stimuli, with head position digitization performed prior to each session to capture 3D coordinates of anatomical landmarks and HPI coils for co-registration.
